content.purpose: Provide a DID-addressed interbank messaging service (ISO 20022 / pacs.008-equivalent customer credit transfer) as an auditable, open-source reference implementation. Companion to open-banking.

architectureDescriptionContext.mission: Provide tamper-evident, DID-native interbank wire messaging open to any AT Protocol client.

content.findings: MVP proven. UETR + ACK chain provides tamper-evident message lineage. Screening DMN gates approval / review / reject paths. AT Protocol audit feed gives federated visibility.
content.recommendations: Add gpi-style status tracker, integrate open-banking transfer settlement, add cryptographic message signing via auth-vault.
